recipe.ghg_method: Published GHG total in Gg CO₂eq, using source AR5 GWP100; converted to tonnes without applying GWP twice. CO₂, CH₄, N₂O and F-gases. Residence-based SEEA accounts; LULUCF excluded. Direct final-demand emissions stored separately and included once in Whole economy.
recipe.gdp_note: Basic-price value added plus net product taxes on intermediate and final uses; tax bridge recovered from the original ADB worksheet.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the explicitly listed value-added rows in the source; product taxes and balancing adjustments are excluded.
recipe.attribution: Asian Development Bank: Key Indicators Database Online (https://kidb.adb.org). Accessed on 2026-10-09. Calculations by MARIO; no endorsement by ADB.
recipe.ghg_basis: SEEA residence-based producer and direct final-demand accounts; AR5 GWP100; excludes LULUCF
recipe.ghg_note: ADB: source AR5 GWP100 totals are converted from Gg to tonnes once. SEEA uses residence-based accounts; EDGAR uses a territorial boundary.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. MARIO calc_trades_content retains contributor origins and final consumers through a projected total-content solve; it does not construct a full inverse.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_trades_content retains production origins. Zero-output emissions stay a quantified unallocated production-origin residual. ADB: source AR5 GWP100 totals are converted from Gg to tonnes once. SEEA uses residence-based accounts; EDGAR uses a territorial boundary. Unallocated zero-output production emissions: 0.000 t CO2eq globally; retained by production origin, with no consumer allocation.
